partnershipPlan: Paramedic educators and two crew representatives review the audit standard; a trauma survivor from the network's patient group reviews the plain-language summary.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: On my own with a bleeding patient on a farm track, drawing up the drug is the last thing I get to.
items.implication: Report compliance by crew configuration and look at single-crew support.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Half the time nobody knows when the tractor rolled; we write our best guess.
items.implication: Separate known and estimated injury times.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: It took them an hour to reach me and another hour to get me to hospital; I just wanted something to stop the bleeding.
items.implication: Report timing by transport time band.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: We would love to know what happened to them in hospital, but without the agreement we cannot look.
items.implication: Keep outcome claims out of the audit report until linkage is permitted.

summary: Four composite voices on single crews, injury time, distance and data sharing.
